findings.summary: Switch.Root (a span role=switch) got no accessible name from a wrapping <label>; NVDA, Narrator and TalkBack announced it unnamed. Fixed in PR #4142 (aria-labelledby) on 2026-02-24. m3 gallery wraps every Switch in <Label>.

shadcn base-nova Switch/Checkbox labels target the hidden input, not the visible control; workarounds are aria-labelledby/id on the label, nativeButton + render={<button />}, or Base UI Field. Reporter says Radix does not have the problem.
Switch lacks a value prop (Checkbox has one). Not used by the gallery.

differences.reference: Root is <button type="button" role="switch" aria-checked value="on">, natively focusable, no tabindex attribute.
differences.branch: Root is <span role="switch" tabindex="0" aria-checked aria-labelledby=...> (base-nova registry file, no nativeButton/render), no button type or value.

reasonNotMoved: The base-nova Switch renders a <span role=switch tabindex=0> plus an always-present hidden checkbox input instead of Radix's native <button role=switch>, and emits data-checked/data-unchecked instead of data-state. This is a perceptible accessibility and DOM difference (verified in the browser against https://m3.khojlabs.com/gallery). Related evidence: https://github.com/mui/base-ui/issues/4122 (wrapping-label name, fixed in #4142) and https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/issues/9249 (open; maintainers recommend nativeButton + render={<button />} to match Radix). Retry once the registry base-nova switch renders a native button (or after deciding to hand-edit it with nativeButton and render={<button />}) and the data-state/hidden-input differences are accepted or removed, then re-compare keyboard and screen reader naming.
